title: 第30章
content:
马寻有些焦头烂额，他的科研进展不顺。如今的酒基本上都是果酒、米酒，酒精度数不高，他又不会酿酒等等。现在在想着蒸馏法，还没有那些精密的仪器。苦思冥想化学，想要采用水化法，依然没有头绪。青霉素他是不敢想的，没有菌种呢，乱用可能费亲戚朋友。他现在在重点研究大蒜素、磺胺类抗生素，可是依然卡在了蒸馏的技术上。得花钱啊，得花钱去制作这些设备。虽然马寻家大业大，暂时不缺钱，也可以找到如今这个世界上手艺最好的工匠等。但是受限于如今的生产力水平，未必就能够达到他的要求。抓耳挠腮的马寻很郁闷，《赤脚医生手册》等，还是看少了。早知道是现在这模样，连《民兵训练手册》也要死记硬背才行。书到用时方恨少，马寻就是暗恨自己的才疏学浅。“舅舅！”一声呼喊打破了马寻的专注，他匆匆走出书房。朱樉抱着一大堆书，殷勤的说道，“母后知道舅舅在研习兵法、医书，特意让我送书过来。”“快放进书房里。”马寻笑着说道，“怎么还让你过来了，随意让人出来一趟就行。”朱樉一边走一边说，“母后还埋怨舅舅不去宫里，父皇前两天还在唠叨。”马寻掐指一算，说道，“我明天入宫，你回去的时候说一声。”朱樉讨好的说道，“舅舅，不是说您这些天一直在城外骑马吗？带着外甥呗？”马寻立刻警惕起来了，“你是皇子，哪能随意出去。”“我先前和老三、老四还在军营里摸爬滚打呢，和将士们一样行军。”朱樉自傲的说道，“别看舅舅这些天常去军营，真要是打绑腿，那可比不上我！”这话不是朱樉自吹自擂，他们兄弟几个对于军营都非常熟悉。马寻还是不放心的问道，“你母后可规定了回宫的时间？”“让我在宫城落闸前回去就行。”朱樉满脸谄媚，“真要是落闸了也没关系，我就歇在舅舅这里，还能有人说什么？”马寻一想也有道理，说道，“那你去叫一声常茂，这些天一直都是他带着我练习骑术。”朱樉嗤之以鼻，不服气的说道，“舅舅，常茂也就是欺负您不常骑马。我们这些个一起长大的，骑术最厉害的是王德，然后就是老四了。”马寻问道，“王德是哪个？怎么没见过？”

朱樉就回答说道，“王弼的大儿子，也是淮西人。先前跟着我丈人，现在跟着常大将军。“马寻一听就觉得不对劲，“你老丈人？你什么时候定的亲事，我怎么没听说过？”“我丈人就是邓愈，肯定要封国公。”朱樉腆着脸说道，“我和他闺女同年，自小就在一起。大哥和大嫂打我们，我和我媳妇就哭。”马寻心里一跳，历史上朱樉的正妃是王保保之妹观音奴，也就是赵敏的原型。但是朱樉不喜欢那位正妃，将她关在冷宫，只给剩饭、坏的水果。而邓愈的女儿虽然是侧妃，可是和朱樉感情非常好。朱樉无法无天的，在王府造龙床、给邓氏穿戴皇后服饰，和邓氏一起以凌虐宫人为乐。在京城的朱樉看着还行，一旦就藩就原形毕露。马寻感慨着说道，“你们兄弟也是厉害，都是自己定亲事，老三和老四也是这样？”朱樉得意说道，“他们可不行，他们没两小无猜的。我这也是和大哥学的，有事情都是大哥顶着。”朱樉开开心心的跑去隔壁了，没多久就听到几个熊孩子吵吵闹闹的声音，常家三兄弟一起出现了。“舅舅，舅母在俺家呢。”常森抢先说道，“俺娘请的人，说是让舅母教我姐女红。”马寻非常不负责任，直接说道，“今天不骑马了！何大，送二皇子回宫！”朱樉急了，非常愤怒，“舅舅，你不讲信义、你不讲道义！”马寻可不管这些，“送二皇子来的人呢？赶紧带他回去，我没工夫和你们闹。”一群臭小子，哪知道什么是正事！徐蛾急匆匆的跑来，说道，“老爷，换身衣裳。咱们换上道袍，显得亲近。”所谓道袍，在明代是很多男子在家中穿的。直领，大襟，两侧开衩，这种服饰上自天子下至士庶无不把道袍当做日常穿著的主要服饰之一。马寻从善如流，徐蛾就继续说道，“老爷再配丝绦，显着更为亲近、随和。”腰间佩玉虽然不错，但是既然穿着道袍，就别佩玉了，还是丝绦更合适一些。朱樉虽然还在不断的叫嚷，可是无济于事。常茂、常升已经在打常森了，都怪老三嘴不严，舅舅不带他们出去玩了。
content_en:
Ma Xun was a little worried, and his scientific research was not progressing smoothly.Today's wines are basically fruit wine and rice wine. The alcohol content is not high, and he doesn't know how to make wine.Now I'm thinking about the distillation method, and we don't have those sophisticated instruments yet.I have been thinking hard about chemistry and want to use the hydration method, but I still have no clue.He didn't dare to think about penicillin. There was no strain of it. If it was used indiscriminately, it might cost relatives and friends.He is currently focusing on researching allicin and sulfonamide antibiotics, but he is still stuck on the distillation technology.You have to spend money, you have to spend money to make these devices.Although the Ma Xun family has a great business and is not short of money for the time being, they can also find the best craftsmen in the world.However, limited by today's productivity levels, it may not be possible to meet his requirements.Ma Xun, who was scratching his head and scratching his head, was very depressed. He still read too little of "The Barefoot Doctor's Manual" and so on.If I had known it would be like this now, I would have to memorize even the "Militia Training Manual".When the book comes to use, he hates it. Ma Xun secretly hates his lack of talent and knowledge."Uncle!" A shout broke Ma Xun's concentration, and he hurried out of the study.Zhu Fang held a large pile of books and said diligently, "My mother knew that my uncle was studying the art of war and medical books, so she asked me to send the books here." "Put them in the study quickly." Ma Xun said with a smile, "Why did you let you come here? Let people come out at will.Just one trip." Zhu Xi said as he walked, "My mother still complained about my uncle not going to the palace, and my father was still nagging me two days ago." Ma Xun counted and said, "I will enter the palace tomorrow, please tell me when I go back."He said, "Uncle, didn't I say that you have been riding horses outside the city these days? Are you taking your nephew with you?" Ma Xun immediately became vigilant, "You are a prince, how can you go out at will." "Earlier, my third and fourth sons and I were still crawling around in the military camp., marching like the soldiers." Zhu Chong said proudly, "Even though my uncle often goes to the military camp these days, if he really wears leggings, he can't compare with me!" This is not Zhu Chong's boasting, the brothers are very familiar with the military camp.Ma Xun still asked worriedly, "Has your mother set a time for returning to the palace?" "Just let me go back before the palace gate is closed." Zhu Xi's face was full of flattery, "It doesn't matter if the gate is closed, I will stay with my uncle. What else can anyone say?" Ma Xun thought about it and said, "Then go and call Chang.Mao, he has been taking me to practice riding these days." Zhu Xi sneered and said unconvinced, "Uncle, Chang Mao is the one who bullied you for not riding a horse often.The one who is the best at riding is Wang De, and then the fourth one." Ma Xun asked, "Which one is Wang De?"

Zhu Ming replied, "Wang Bi's eldest son is also from Huaixi. He used to follow my father-in-law, and now he follows General Chang." Ma Xun felt something was wrong when he heard this, "Your father-in-law? When did you arrange the marriage? Why haven't I heard of it?" "My father-in-law is Deng Yu., he must be made a duke." Zhu Xiang said with a shy face, "I am the same age as his daughter, and we have been together since childhood.When my elder brother and sister-in-law beat us, my wife and I cried." Ma Xun's heart skipped a beat. Historically, Zhu Xiang's first concubine was Wang Baobao's sister Guanyinnu, who was the prototype of Zhao Min.But Zhu Xi didn't like the concubine, so he locked her up in the cold palace and gave her only leftover food and bad fruits.Although Deng Yu's daughter was a concubine, she had a very good relationship with Zhu Ping.Zhu Fang was lawless and built a dragon bed in the palace, dressed Deng in queen's clothes, and enjoyed abusing the palace people together with Deng.Zhu Xiang looked okay in the capital, but once he became a feudal lord, his true colors were revealed.Ma Xun said with emotion, "You brothers are also great. You all get married by yourself. Is this the case for the third and fourth children?" Zhu Ping said proudly, "They are not good. They don't have childhood sweethearts. I also learned this from my eldest brother, who takes care of everything." Zhu Ping happily ran to the next door. Not long after, he heard the noise of several naughty children, and the three brothers of the Chang family appeared together."Uncle, my aunt is at my house." Chang Sen said first, "The person my mother invited was for my aunt to teach my sister how to be red." Ma Xun was very irresponsible and said directly, "No riding today! He Da, send the second prince back to the palace!" Zhu Cang was anxious.He was very angry, "Uncle, you are unfaithful and unrighteous!" Ma Xun didn't care about this, "Where is the person who sent the second prince here? Take him back quickly, I don't have time to make trouble with you." A bunch of brats, how can they know what business is!Xu Mo hurried over and said, "Master, change your clothes. Let's put on Taoist robes to look closer." The so-called Taoist robes were worn by many men at home in the Ming Dynasty.With a straight collar, wide lapel, and slits on both sides, this kind of clothing has been regarded as one of the main garments for daily wear by everyone from the emperor to the common people.Ma Xun followed the good example, and Xu Mo continued, "If you wear a silk ribbon with me, you will be more approachable and easy-going." Although it is good to wear jade on the waist, since you are wearing a Taoist robe, don't wear jade. A silk ribbon is more suitable.Although Zhu Ping kept shouting, it was to no avail.Chang Mao and Chang Sheng were already beating Chang Sen. It was all because the third child was lax and their uncle stopped taking them out to play.
